name: The Power of Pine
summary: Sergeant Hartman asks you to clear Forsaken stink bombs from Southshore during Hallow’s End. A pine-scented cleaner is meant to keep the village clean.

sections.title: Southshore’s Stink
sections.body: The Forsaken use stink bombs on Southshore during Hallow’s End, turning the celebration of liberation into a foul mess. Sergeant Hartman asks you to remove any that have landed in the village with a Stink Bomb Cleaner.

faq.q: Who asks me to clean up the stink bombs?
faq.answer: Sergeant Hartman in Southshore asks you to clear the Forsaken stink bombs.
The stink bombs are in Southshore.

faq.q: Who uses stink bombs on Southshore?
faq.answer: The Forsaken use stink bombs on Southshore during Hallow’s End.
The Stink Bomb Cleaner uses the power of pine to fight foul smells.
The Forsaken stink bombs make a smelly mess during Southshore’s Hallow’s End celebration.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can help Sergeant Hartman keep Southshore clean of Forsaken stink bombs.
